description: Shared Renovate preset: keeps the lint, format, git-hook and compiler tooling on the same versions in every repo that extends it as github>ebalzan/ci//renovate/tooling#v2. Only the packages listed below are managed; every other dependency is left alone.

packageRules.description: Only the shared tooling below is managed; every other dependency (framework, runtime, GitHub Actions) stays manual.
One PR per repo for the shared tooling, including the two @ebalzan packages (majors get their own PR). chore keeps the branch type and the PR title in step for pr-title.
typescript-eslint (used directly, or through eslint-config-next / eslint-config-expo) only supports typescript <6.1. Raise this once it does.
